criterion_scale.1: partially satisfied without a complete supported conclusion
criterion_scale.2: fully satisfied with correct engineering meaning

final_outcome_scoring.external_goal_coverage: sum required criterion scores / (2 * number of required criteria)
final_outcome_scoring.external_goal_success: all required criteria score 2 AND every critical numeric target passes AND no engineering contradiction AND correct required hypothesis handling
final_outcome_scoring.claim_accuracy: fraction of benchmark GT claims correctly and explicitly represented; unknown or absent claims do not count as correct
final_outcome_scoring.hallucination: unsupported material factual invention, fabricated value or evidence, or false factual certainty
final_outcome_scoring.engineering_contradiction: claim contradicts a cited or benchmark source's engineering meaning
final_outcome_scoring.evidence_grounding: fraction of material claims accompanied by a real, semantically supporting citation; missing citation is not supporting evidence
final_outcome_scoring.hypothesis_handling: for contradicted targets explicitly refuse the requested false conclusion and present the correction; null expected_result is not a hypothesis task
final_outcome_scoring.impossible_goal_detection: on conflicts_with_evidence tasks, explicitly mark target unsupported rather than force it
final_outcome_scoring.insufficient_evidence_detection: on insufficient_evidence tasks, explicitly mark the unanswerable requested quantity/claim undetermined and identify missing evidence
final_outcome_scoring.numeric: deterministic value and compatible unit comparison against fixed absolute tolerance; a number for a different physical quantity fails
final_outcome_scoring.final_answer_only: condition and iteration metadata are hidden during final review

process_scoring.iteration_curve: last observation carried forward through the frozen four-iteration horizon; only actual candidate answers may raise coverage
process_scoring.self_correction: a criterion scored 0 in first actual iteration and 2 in final answer, or a first-iteration engineering error corrected in final answer
process_scoring.useful_replanning: after a replan, at least one of new relevant evidence, external criterion increase, corrected engineering error, or validated required computation; changed query text alone never suffices
process_scoring.new_evidence_acquisition: a later iteration adds a distinct source ID that supports a fixed GT claim or criterion
process_scoring.no_progress_stop_correctness: stops for no_progress only when no criterion/evidence/computation gain in the patience window
process_scoring.unnecessary_iteration: later iteration yields no new relevant evidence, criterion gain, correction, or required computation
process_scoring.calibration_error: absolute difference between internal final goal coverage and external final goal coverage
process_scoring.overconfidence: internal achieved status with external goal success false

python_scoring.selection_precision: selected tasks expected required or optional / all selected tasks
python_scoring.selection_recall: selected required tasks / all required tasks
python_scoring.calculation_success: required tasks with at least one validated computation / required tasks
python_scoring.calculation_accuracy: required-task critical numeric target pass rate in final answer
python_scoring.calc_provenance_correctness: validated CALC claim cites both computation and source evidence
python_scoring.repair_success: failed first Python attempt followed by validated later attempt / tasks with an actual failed first attempt
python_scoring.unnecessary_python: Python calls on not_needed tasks / all Python calls

review_qa: Keep original semantic reviews immutable. Flag disagreements with deterministic numeric, figure-file, source-ID and hypothesis-status checks. Any adjudication is a separate v1.1 artifact.
